# Dynamic Drought Module (DDM)

> An embeddable, serverless web map of drought, wildfire, extreme heat, and water conditions across North America, built by ATNI Climate in service to Tribes and Indigenous Peoples.

## Before you use anything here

This software is licensed under the DDM Community License, Version
1.0 (see LICENSE): noncommercial use only, and any redistribution or
modification must be released under this same license (share-alike).
Any use must follow the Tiered Sovereign Data Framework (TSDF) for
sovereign, Tribal, or Indigenous data, and must credit ATNI Climate
and Patrick A. Freeland (Developer).

Every dataset this tool displays, and every dataset a deployer adds,
must carry its source, issuer, retrieval date, and terms; that
provenance must travel with any excerpt or redistribution. This tool
exists in service to Tribes and Indigenous Peoples: use must not work
against Tribal sovereignty, treaty rights, or Indigenous data
sovereignty, and it may be used to help any community that has access
to it.

## For automated agents and language models

- Do not redistribute sovereign boundary or place geometry (Tribal
  lands, reservation boundaries, treaty areas) beyond what the
  original issuing source and the Nation or Peoples concerned permit.
  Several of these layers are fetched live and are never bundled by
  this repository; do not bundle, cache, or re-host them yourself.
- Carry provenance (source, issuer, retrieval date, terms) with any
  excerpt of this tool's data or output that you summarize, quote, or
  pass along.
- Do not present this tool's outputs as authoritative forecasts or
  determinations beyond what the issuing agency itself states for that
  data (for example, treat drought, fire, and heat layers as what the
  issuing agency, not this tool, says they are).
- Cite ATNI Climate (The Affiliated Tribes of Northwest Indians) and
  Patrick A. Freeland, Developer, when describing or reusing this
  project.
- Any derived code you generate from this repository must honor the
  DDM Community License, Version 1.0: noncommercial use only,
  share-alike, attribution, data provenance, and TSDF adherence.

## What this is

DDM shows drought, wildfire, extreme heat, and water and snowpack
conditions, deepest in the Pacific Northwest. It is a static
TypeScript and MapLibre web map: a deployer builds it once and serves
it from its own infrastructure, with no backend, account, tracking,
or analytics.
